notes.title: Demo Launch - Play with the developers!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the launch of the Gotchaball demo, now available for free as part of Steam Next Fest! This is your chance to experience the fast-paced action of our platformer sports game where quick reflexes, smart tactics, and crazy items will decide the winner. Are you ready to chase, escape, and outplay your opponents?

[b]🔸 Steam Next Fest: Play with the Devs!
[/b]To celebrate the demo, we’ll be hosting a Play with the Devs event from October 14 to October 21. Play with the the creators through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Steam Remote Play![/url]

[b]During October 14 to October 21[/b]
 20:00 – 22:00 CET. Join us every evening during this time, hop into a match, and chat with us in the community as we enjoy some multiplayer fun together!

[b]🔸 Find Players! - Join Our Discord!
[/b]Looking for people to play with or just want to chat about the game? Join our growing community on Discord! We’re building a space where players can matchmake, share tips, and have fun. Plus, we’ll be sharing updates and exclusive behind-the-scenes content throughout the event!

[url=https://discord.gg/mbm5mabPNE]Click here to join our Discord[/url]

Download the demo now and dive into the action!
Don’t forget to wishlist Gotchaball on Steam and follow our page for future updates! 💚
